## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks run and their results.

## Elixir branches and conditions

For new or changed decisions, map each reachable branch and condition outcome to
named behavioral tests, including short-circuit and boundary cases. Explain any
infeasible outcomes, or mark this section not applicable when no Elixir decisions
change. See `docs/testing-and-coverage.md`, section "Required branch and condition tests".

Line coverage and mutation scores do not establish branch/condition coverage.
